title: Why Soda Through a Straw STINGS: Straw Nucleation
caption:
Why soda through a straw hits like a fizz bomb
A cartoon guy sips iced cola, then bursts into wincing tears as bubbles explode around his face - and a chart names the culprit: straw nucleation.
Straw friction acts as a nucleation site, so CO2 escapes in a rapid burst of micro-bubbles that triggers nociceptor firing - the fizz literally hurts.
Does the first fizzy sip make you wince, or do you chug straight from the can?
Save this for your next soda run and follow @fruit_drama_tv for daily science.
